description: 三兵对双兵③：外通路兵 — f兵是外通路兵，黑方双兵无法应对三路进攻

intro.popup_en: White has an outside passed f-pawn with no opposing f-pawn. Black has only g- and h-pawns. The f-pawn will tie down the black king while the g- and h-pawns break through.
intro.popup: 💡 外通路兵：白方 f2 是外通路兵（黑方无 f 兵对应），黑方只有 g7+h7 双兵。白方三兵推进，f 兵将牵制黑王，g/h 兵随后突破。

outro.popup_en: White wins. The black king must chase the f-pawn, leaving the g- and h-pawns free to advance and promote.
outro.popup: ✅ 结论：白胜！ 黑王被迫追赶 f 兵，g/h 兵趁机升变。

moves.popup_en: 1. f4: the outside passed f-pawn leads the advance.
1...Kf7: the black king prepares to block the pawn.
2...Ke7: the black king chases the f-pawn and cannot attend to the g- and h-pawns.
moves.popup: 2...Ke7 — 黑王追赶 f 兵，无法兼顾 g/h 兵。

moves.popup_en: 3. g4: the g-pawn joins the advance, creating a second front.
moves.popup: 3.g4 — g 兵跟进！黑方无力招架两路威胁。

moves.popup_en: 3...Kf6 blocks the f-pawn, but the g- and h-pawns are already beyond its reach.
moves.popup: 3...Kf6 — 黑王阻挡 f 兵，但 g/h 兵已无拦截。

moves.popup_en: 4. h4: all three pawns advance, and White has a decisive position.
moves.popup: 4.h4 — 三兵全面推进，白胜定局！
